sentences.text: Amit vs The State Of Rajasthan on 6 November, 2025

In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No.4778 /2025
 [@ Slp [Crl.] No.15168/2025]
 Amit Appellant(s)
 Versus
 The State Of Rajasthan Respondent(s)
 O R D E R
Leave granted.

The appellant apprehends his arrest in connection with FIR No.51/2022, registered at Police Station Surajpole, District-Udaipur, Rajasthan for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467,
468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

Taking into consideration the fact that the appellant has already joined the investigation and cooperating with same, as well as upon considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, the impugned order stands set aside and the appellant is granted anticipatory bail on the terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The appeal stands allowed, accordingly.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
M.M. SUNDRESH] .J.
